application_credentials.description:
Follow the [instructions]({more_info_url}) to create OAuth2 credentials for Gmail API access:
1. Go to [Credentials]({oauth_creds_url}) and create an **OAuth client ID**.
2. Set Application Type to **Web application**.
3. Configure the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}) with scope `gmail.readonly`.

auth.title: Connect Gmail
auth.description: Authorize Shop2Parcel to read your Gmail inbox so it can detect Shopify shipping confirmation emails. Only read access is requested.

finish.title: Configure Shop2Parcel
finish.description: Enter your parcelapp.net API key and choose a name for this integration entry.

data_description.api_key: Found in the parcelapp app under Settings > API.
data_description.name: A name to identify this integration entry (e.g. "Shop2Parcel (you@gmail.com)").

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Gmail
reauth_confirm.description: Your Gmail authorization has expired or been revoked. Click below to re-authorize Shop2Parcel.

user.title: Connect Shop2Parcel
user.description: Choose how to connect to your email account. You can add multiple accounts by running setup again.

data_description.connection_type: Select 'Gmail OAuth2' to connect via Google OAuth2, or 'IMAP' to connect via IMAP with username and password (app password).

imap.title: Configure IMAP Account
imap.description: Enter your IMAP server credentials. Use an app password if your provider requires two-factor authentication.

data_description.imap_port: 993 for SSL, 143 for STARTTLS or unencrypted.
data_description.imap_password: Your email password or app-specific password.
data_description.imap_verify_tls: Verify the server's TLS certificate (recommended). Disable only for self-signed certificates on a trusted local server.

reauth_imap.title: Re-enter IMAP Credentials
reauth_imap.description: IMAP authentication failed. Please re-enter your password.

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid parcelapp.net API key. Check the key in parcelapp Settings and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to parcelapp.net. Check your network connection and try again.
error.oauth_error: Google authorization failed. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: IMAP authentication failed. Check username and password.
error.imap_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the IMAP server. Check hostname, port, and TLS mode.

abort.already_configured: Shop2Parcel is already configured for this Gmail account.
abort.already_configured_imap: An account with this username and host is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Wrong account: please re-authenticate with the originally configured account. To switch accounts, remove this entry and add a new one.

settings.title: Shop2Parcel Settings
settings.description: Configure polling and Ollama AI extraction. Always-extracted fields: {locked_fields}.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to check for new shipping emails (5–1440 minutes).
data_description.gmail_query: Gmail search query to find shipping emails. The default matches shipping emails by subject keywords (tracking, shipped, shipment, delivery, etc.) regardless of sender. Clearing this field restores the default. Existing entries keep their stored query until manually cleared.
data_description.imap_verify_tls: Verify the IMAP server's TLS certificate (recommended). Disable only for self-signed certificates on a trusted local server.
data_description.rescan_window_days: Always look back at least this many days for shipping emails (7-365). Increase this to rescan recent history without resetting the integration. Already-forwarded shipments are not re-sent.
data_description.ollama_url: Ollama server base URL (e.g. http://192.168.0.190:11434). Leave empty to disable AI extraction.
data_description.ollama_model: Ollama model tag (e.g. qwen3.5:2b). Must be pulled on the Ollama server.
data_description.queue_maxlen: Maximum number of emails queued for AI extraction (1–256).

data_description.field_name: Lowercase letters, digits, underscores. Must start with a letter. Max 32 characters.
data_description.field_description: Optional hint for the AI (e.g. 'ISO 8601 estimated delivery date').

error.ollama_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Ollama server. Check the URL and port, and ensure Ollama is running.
error.ollama_model_not_found: Model {missing_model} not found on the Ollama server. Run: ollama pull {missing_model}
error.invalid_field_name: Invalid field name. Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores. Must start with a letter (max 32 chars).
error.locked_field_collision: This field name is reserved and cannot be used as a custom field.
error.invalid_imap_search: IMAP search criteria must not contain control characters (such as line breaks).
